data.description: At 8th level, as an immediate action upon successfully hitting an opponent with a melee attack, you reduce the remaining duration of all beneficial magical effects currently affecting the target by I round, minute, hour, or day-whichever measurement is used to determine the duration of each particular magical effect. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|DomainChaosLVL/4-1
